fieldValues.title: A good pull request is defined once, and each repository adds only its local checks
fieldValues.move: The handbook states what every pull request carries (the issue it closes, what changed and how it was tested, its decision mode and, where it changes a ruling, its door) and generates a PR template from that text for every governed repo. A repo adds its own lines (srs's Cell, srs-web's branch name) to the template, never a different base.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: Whether the change is right; the template only makes a PR judgeable.
fieldValues.falsifier: After the template exists, PRs still fail a repo's check for a line the template did not ask for.
